title: BBQ Chicken Pizza
summary: Smoky barbecue chicken, pineapple and red onion on a crisp, cheesy base.
ingredients: 1/2 cup barbecue sauce, plus extra to drizzle
steps: Preheat the oven to 230°C (450°F) with a tray or pizza stone inside.
Toss the shredded chicken in half of the barbecue sauce.
Spread the remaining sauce over the pizza base, leaving a small border.
Scatter over the mozzarella, then the chicken, pineapple and red onion.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and the crust is golden.
Drizzle with a little extra barbecue sauce, top with coriander, slice and serve.

title: Fluffy Banana Pancakes
summary: A tall stack of soft pancakes topped with banana, almonds and maple syrup.
ingredients: Flaked almonds, mint and maple syrup, to serve
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt together in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg, melted butter and mashed banana.
Pour the wet mix into the dry and stir until just combined — a few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat and pour in 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top, then flip and cook for another minute.
Stack, top with sliced banana and almonds, and finish with maple syrup and mint.

title: Double Cheeseburger
summary: Two juicy smashed patties, melted cheese, pickles and a tangy burger sauce.
ingredients: Lettuce, sliced tomato, onion and pickles
Sauce: 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp pickle juice
steps: Mix the sauce ingredients together and set aside.
Divide the beef into 4 balls and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat a heavy pan until very hot. Add the balls and smash them flat with a spatula.
Cook for 2 minutes until well browned, flip, add a slice of cheese to each and cook 1 minute more.
Spread sauce on both halves of each bun.
Layer lettuce, tomato, pickles, two patties and onion, then close the bun and serve.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
summary: Soft paneer cubes in a rich, creamy tomato and cashew gravy, served with rice.
ingredients: Salt, coriander leaves and steamed basmati rice, to serve
steps: Melt the butter in a pan and fry the onion until soft and golden.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cashews and cook until the tomatoes break down, about 8 minutes.
Cool slightly, then blend to a smooth paste and return it to the pan.
Stir in the chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala and salt; simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the paneer and cream, simmer for 3–4 minutes, garnish with coriander and serve over rice.

title: Penne Bolognese
summary: A hearty, slow-simmered meat sauce tossed through penne and finished with parmesan.
ingredients: 1 onion, 1 carrot and 1 celery stick, finely diced
Salt, black pepper and grated parmesan
steps: Heat the olive oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 6–8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and minced meat and cook, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the crushed tomatoes and oregano.
Season, cover and simmer gently for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the penne in well-salted water until al dente, then drain.
Toss the penne through the sauce and serve topped with parmesan and black pepper.
